scope: The sky of the first screen (prototypes/corridor/sky/), less its meaning links, which are a proprietary_safe record set of their own (proprietary_safe/sky-sem.json). sky/mount.mjs joins the two in memory.
notes: 戠 family (kanji-family.json): One attributed family, not an exhaustive phonetic series or a historical-form reconstruction.

Sound part: a top-level written part of the kanji that is itself a kanji, is not the kanji's classical radical, and carries one of the kanji's on-readings by exact string equality. A sound family lists kanji that share one such part and reading.
Part meanings for parts that are not kanji in the table are standard radical meanings written by hand in build_sky_data.py.

Characters outside the app's character table (11th element 1) and the third source of word glosses come from share_alike/reference-extra.json: kanjiMetadata and kanjiFacts for the characters, extraWords for the glosses.
